Anyone with your backup can control your wallet. The saved JSON file is not encrypted. Android authentication protects the export step, not the saved file. Keep a safe copy and never share it.

Import the JSON backup into a compatible Saito wallet to restore your identity and wallet settings. If you lose this phone or uninstall the app without a backup, you may permanently lose access. Your signing keys are stored on this device, not our server.

A wallet backup does not include all cached Chat history. Available history depends on the selected server and compatible peers. Some older messages may be unavailable after restoring on another device.
